--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-1] Middleware bypasses auth on missing publishable key
File: src/middleware.ts (L10-L28)
Evidence: The middleware checks if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) then logs and returns NextResponse.next(), effectively skipping all auth enforcement when that env var is absent. This uses a client-side publishable key presence to gate server-side protection.  
Impact: Misconfiguration (missing env) will silently expose protected routes (including /admin and /api/admin/*), causing a full trust-boundary failure if deployed without that variable.  
Fix: Require/validate a server-side Clerk secret (not NEXT_PUBLIC_ var) and fail closed (return 500 or redirect) instead of skipping auth.

[AUTH-2] Unindexed clerkId causes table scans on auth lookups
File: src/app/api/admin/check-admin/route.ts (L1-L40)
Evidence: Handlers call prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { clerkId: userId } }) in multiple admin endpoints, while prisma/schema.prisma defines clerkId: String? with no index or unique constraint.  
Impact: Each authenticated admin request that resolves the current user by clerkId will trigger a full table scan as the user base grows, leading to DB CPU spikes and auth-path overload at scale.  
Fix: Add an index or unique constraint on User.clerkId in Prisma (and migrate) and switch to findUnique where possible to make provider-id lookups constant-time.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[AUTH-3] Admin endpoints do heavy DB work after auth (N+1 risk)
File: src/app/api/admin/abandoned-carts/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: After auth, the route loads many partial checkouts then Promise.all -> prisma.cart.findUnique and per-item prisma.product.findUnique (nested lookups), producing N+1 queries.  
Impact: Admin dashboard/API calls can become slow and cause DB load spikes under moderate concurrency, amplifying auth-path load.  
Fix: Batch/includes in queries (join related rows), paginate results, or prefetch product data in a single query to avoid N+1 f
